Explainer: spread vs price

evergreen
The spread and the moneyline answer different questions.

The spread is the market's guess at the margin. The moneyline is its guess at who wins.

Wednesday: New England's spread moved half a point. Its price moved from +160 to +142.

Only one of those questions changed.

Explainer: what a 55-point spread means

Thu
A 55-point spread is a scoring projection in disguise.

Average the total and the spread and you get the market's own final score.

Miami 58.5, Florida A&M 3.

The board isn't being rude. It's being arithmetic.
